name: SettingsPageTemplate
need: The settings archetype has no carrier: workshops built the cleanest settings screen in the portfolio by hand (SettingRow with label+explanation left / control right, write-only secret fields marked 'configured', five grouped sections), both ProfilePages hand-assemble a lighter version, and energy-cloud outside the monorepo needed a whole multi-section settings area. Every next product will need one, and today each starts from a blank div.

consideredAlternatives.whyNot: Settings are not a collection to narrow: no toolbar, no empty state driven by filters, and rows are explained knobs, not records.
Settings are a PAGE read by scanning group labels, not a submitted form; most rows apply on change and there is no single confirm.
The status quo: workshops did it correctly once as app-local SettingRow, both ProfilePages did it again worse, and the next app starts from zero.

proposedApi.SettingsPageTemplate: title, actions, children — a deliberately NARROW column (52rem knob, co-located) with the header inside it, because a title flush to the page edge above a centred column reads as two screens
proposedApi.SettingsSection: title, description, children — a Card whose head names the group; group by who a knob affects (Linear's lesson: me / workspace / admins)
proposedApi.SettingRow: label, description, htmlFor, badge, children — name and what-it-actually-affects left, control right; the explanation is the point (workshops' proven contract). A destructive action is a plain row with a destructive Button, no red frame

sources: workshops SettingsPage (live case, SettingRow contract), Shopify settings template (two-column bands, scannable left rail of labels), Linear settings architecture (grouping by scope)
decision: Build as a block per the golden-screens G2 batch; workshops migrates onto it (and its app-local SettingRow retires) next time workshops is touched for feature work.
